name: lichess-club-outreach
description: Human-in-the-loop Lichess club outreach: parse a club, rank candidates, generate personalized invites with an LLM, review them, send with pacing, and track who joined.

LICHESS_TOKEN.description: Personal Lichess API token with msg:write (and team:read for private teams).

LICHESS_USERNAME.description: Lichess account that sends the invitations.

SENPAI_TEAM_ID.description: Target Lichess team id that candidates are invited to.

SOURCE_CLUB_ID.description: Lichess club id that is parsed for candidates.

LLM_API_KEY.description: OpenRouter (or OpenAI-compatible) API key used to write invitation drafts.

LLM_MODEL.description: Chat model used for invitation drafts.

LLM_BASE_URL.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL of the LLM provider.

MESSAGE_LANGUAGE.description: Language code of generated and fallback messages.

SEND_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: Delay between two outgoing direct messages, in seconds.

DAILY_SEND_LIMIT.description: Maximum number of direct messages per UTC day.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Token that protects /api/* and the review UI; generated by Heroku.
